items.problem: "reconnection of `Disconnected` participants uses signaling again" does not set what happens to signals made while the matchmaker connection is down. Lines 115 to 119 do not say whether `PEER_SIGNAL` made with no matchmaker connection is queued or dropped, and line 104 gives the transport no time limit. Run path: index 0 calls `connect_peer` for a `Disconnected` index 1 while the matchmaker connection is lost. When the offer is dropped, in-match rejoin succeeds and index 1 gets `PEER_REJOINED`, drops its waiting connection and waits for an offer (line 130), while index 0 does not restart its connection. Both reach `PeerLeftEvent`(`Timeout`) at the reconnect time limit. This existed before the diff
